2: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
3: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
4: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
5: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
6: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
7: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
8: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
9: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
10: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.
11: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
12: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.
13: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
14: Consider her defenses. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
15: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
